# Cognia Noir

Cognia Noir is a Notion- and Zen-inspired dark and light theme with rounded sidebars, a lifted note panel and SF Pro fonts. macOS vibrancy can be enabled to let the wallpaper show through, while the theme keeps plugin-safe rendering, WCAG AA contrast, reduced-motion support and hover feedback.

![Cognia Noir screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/randomusername21349/cognia-noir/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Cognia Noir"
    author: "randomusername21349"
    repo:   "randomusername21349/cognia-noir"
    slug:   "cognia-noir"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/cognia-noir"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/randomusername21349/cognia-noir"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/randomusername21349/cognia-noir/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a Notion- and Zen-inspired dark/light theme for calm reading with rounded sidebars, a lifted note panel, and SF Pro fonts. Enable macOS vibrancy to let wallpaper show through while keeping plugin-safe rendering, WCAG AA contrast, reduced-motion support, and snappy hover feedback."
}
```
